messages:
lee: quick follow-up from RFC: we need a practical rollout metadata shape. artifact vs lease debate reopened.

maria: hybrid seems best: immutable artifact ids for provenance + short-lived placement leases for runtime GC.

daan: agree. leases should be opaque UUIDs stored in a TTL-backed KV. link leases -> artifact_id for debugging.

tess: manifest must be tiny so clients cache. include artifact_id, semantic_tag, compat_labels, eval_score, release_channel, deprecated_hint.

lee: runtime fallback policy: if chosen pool lacks artifact, consult compat_labels ordered by eval_score and stability tier. annotate responses when fallback occurs.

maria: telemetry events: {requested_artifact, served_artifact, lease_id, reason} and a regression hook to trigger evals when fallbacks are frequent.

daan: GC proposal: keep artifact if referenced by active lease OR within retention_window_days OR customer_pinned. otherwise candidate for deletion.

tess: API surfaces: GET /manifests/:id (tiny manifest), POST /leases (returns lease_id), GET /leases/:id. clients cache manifests short (eg 60s).

lee: action items: maria draft JSON schema, daan prototype lease store + GC, tess draft fallback telemetry. ops-bot: create card.

ops-bot: Created task REDWOOD-2042: hybrid rollout metadata + telemetry. Assignees: maria, daan, tess.

lee: plan to lock fields Friday and open RFC PR. add any other concerns here.
